policy.causal_rule: A fail-closed script does not make a stale published artifact safe. Distinguish local generation, artifact upload and public publication. Do not reintroduce automatic main writes as a shortcut.

edges.claim: The current summary generator refuses to create a directional summary when source confidence is zero or provider status is unavailable and writes NOT_ISSUED instead.
The workflow is manual-dispatch-only, read-only and uploads a 30-day artifact; it does not commit or publish generated output to main.
The tracked public summary still narrates the older score-44/news-88 signal, while the inspected workflow only uploads a new artifact and does not update the tracked file.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The public summary is stale primarily because the safe workflow no longer publishes generated artifacts to main.
disconfirming_evidence: Other workflows or manual publication paths may exist; they were not exhaustively inspected in this capture.
